status: Motor-removed static test fixture candidate, not a powered brake or tested fixture

additional_hardware.note: One additional hub; do not remove the S2 hub. This locks the input to the fixture when the motor/coupler are removed.
6 mm nominal thread engagement after the 6 mm recess; verify actual hub thread and no protrusion.

additional_hardware.specification: At least 100 mm usable jaw width and 20 mm foot engagement; securely bolted bench
additional_hardware.note: Grip only the rectangular foot; shim and clamp the rear cradle to carry gearbox weight and wrench side load.

additional_hardware.specification: Calibrated beam, dial or digital tool reading 1 to 5 Nm in the test direction, preferably 1/4 inch square drive
additional_hardware.note: A 20-200 Nm wrench cannot measure this test. A click-only tool cannot show sustained load or relaxation. Record accuracy and calibration, or borrow a suitable tool.

additional_hardware.specification: Fits torque tool and 12 REX output; Wera 05003510001 from SA1 can be reused for the direct-shaft test
additional_hardware.note: At least 10 mm measured usable shaft engagement, no bottoming or contact with collar; socket not retained by the shaft for this hand test.

additional_hardware.specification: Two suitable bench clamps and flat shims; optional two M6 through bolts with washers/nuts for a drilled base
additional_hardware.note: Height depends on the actual vise and bench. Do not let the gearbox cantilever from the printed fixture.

additional_hardware.specification: Spare goBILDA 2109-4012-0640, 12 mm REX steel shaft, 64 mm
additional_hardware.note: For isolated SA1 static test. Reuse its collar; keep the assembled gearbox separate. Check 11 mm socket grip on the exposed test-shaft end.

additional_hardware.specification: Straight steel 6.35 mm hex test piece with at least 10 mm usable socket engagement and enough vise grip
additional_hardware.note: A long straight 1/4 inch screwdriver-bit shank can be checked for fit; exclude reduced necks, grooves and tapered ends from loaded contact. Do not use the grinder as the restraint.

limits: No motor may be installed or powered while the input is locked
Static output load does not establish operating efficiency, speed, impact, heat, wear or fatigue
Printed fixture strength and vise retention have not been tested
Physical hub, shaft, spacer and tool-access fits remain unverified
Test the adapter separately; direct-shaft loading bypasses it
